title: review-bot issue sweep (#11-#13)
description:
Implement every issue currently open on olli/review-bot: #11, #12, and #13. Restore repo-audit checkout lifecycle correctness and harden the credential-free Unix-socket client so connection failures are precise, traceback-free, and conservative about unknown outcomes. Preserve established PR review, issue triage, repo-audit, protocol, and output behavior outside the referenced fixes.

Acceptance: every tests/test_*.py script exits 0; the Nix package builds; in-use integration exercises the actual client against successful and abruptly failing fake Unix-socket peers and exercises repo-audit with realistic and degenerate local Git trees plus fake Forgejo/engine dependencies. The eventual PR must include Closes #11, Closes #12, and Closes #13.

title: Harden client diagnostics and indeterminate connection-loss handling (#12, #13)
description:
Closes #12, #13.

Update client.py and focused client protocol tests. Replace every user-facing reference to the nonexistent review-bot.socket unit with review-bot-review.socket. Keep missing-socket and refused-connection hints focused on the real unit and REVIEW_BOT_SOCKET. Give PermissionError its own concise diagnostic naming review-bot-review.socket, the review-bot-client supplementary group, and the possibility that a login/session or long-running user manager must be restarted after group changes. All failures must remain traceback-free and nonzero.

Handle abrupt connection loss during send, shutdown, and response reading, including ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError, and equivalent supported-runtime errors. A complete final result remains authoritative: preserve ok:true output/exit behavior even if the peer then resets, and preserve ok:false error/exit behavior. If transport is lost or clean EOF occurs before a final result, exit nonzero with one concise diagnostic stating that the service connection was lost, the review outcome is unknown and may already have posted, and the caller must inspect the target or service journal before retrying. Never retry automatically or infer success. Preserve malformed/unknown NDJSON forward compatibility unless it prevents receiving the result.

Add stdlib-only deterministic tests with no live systemd, Forgejo, or engine. Test exact exit status and full stdout/stderr for FileNotFoundError, ConnectionRefusedError, and PermissionError. Use an actual client subprocess plus a fake local Unix-socket peer for reset before response, log then reset, complete success then close/reset, explicit ok:false, clean EOF without result, and clean success. Include a successful service-path assertion that a complete final result is emitted and the service path exits 0; fix a repository-local cleanup/shutdown defect only if the test exposes one.

Acceptance: no client text names review-bot.socket; all specified diagnostics and protocol cases pass; the running client integration proves observable output and exit semantics for realistic success and degenerate abrupt-loss data.

title: Restore repo-audit Checkout lifecycle and cleanup (#11)
description:
Closes #11.

Update do_repo_audit() in review.py for the current prepare_head_checkout() contract: receive (Checkout, head_sha), enter the Checkout context, use checkout.wt as the only repository path, and keep every checkout-dependent operation inside the context. This includes convention discovery and all generation, verification, and synthesis engine calls. Ensure context exit and private-worktree/temp-ref cleanup occur after successful dry-run, print-only, and normal issue-creation paths and after injected generation or verification failures. Preserve repo-audit rendering, output format, issue deduplication, create-issue behavior, PR review, and issue triage. Do not change the Checkout or prepare_head_checkout APIs.

Replace the obsolete raw-path test double in tests/test_repo_audit.py with a realistic context-manager double exposing a distinct .wt path and recording entry/exit. Tests must fail if the Checkout object itself reaches filesystem or subprocess APIs, prove entry precedes checkout-dependent work, prove engine cwd is .wt, and prove __exit__ on success and failure while retaining dry-run, print-only, deduplication, and create-issue coverage. Exercise the repo-audit pipeline with a realistic local Git tree containing source/convention content and a degenerate minimal tree, using only fake Forgejo and engine dependencies; assert observable rendered/output behavior.

Acceptance: repo mode never treats Checkout as a path, always cleans it up on every specified path, all existing behavior remains intact, and the running pipeline integration succeeds without live Forgejo or a real review harness.

title: Disclose finder-stage provenance; skip verify on empty draft (forgejo olli/review-bot#20)
description: review.py: skip the verify engine call when a generator draft has zero findings (modes pr/repo); carry per-harness draft->surviving provenance out of run_pipeline as a tuple and disclose it in the review and audit renderers (two disclosure lines + a footer 'findings' segment). New tests/test_empty_draft.py, README update. Verdict semantics unchanged: an empty finder draft stays green, disclosed not failed.
close_reason: All acceptance criteria implemented; tests and Nix build pass

title: run_pipeline: skip verify on empty draft + return (result, provenance) tuple
description: review.py:945-965. When the generator result's findings list is empty, do not invoke the verifier (modes pr/repo). Record per-harness provenance {harness, draft_count, surviving_count} for generator stages that produced a usable result, plus whether a synthesis stage ran. Return (result, provenance) — NEVER stuff provenance into the normalized dict: synth_fill JSON-dumps those dicts into engine prompts (:1054,:1107,:1154). Update call sites do_pr_review (:1067-1068), do_repo_audit (:1167-1173) to unpack and pass through; do_issue_triage (:1120-1121) unpacks and ignores.

title: Renderers: disclosure lines + footer findings segment
description: render_markdown (:835-863) and render_audit_markdown (:888-928) accept provenance. Exact strings per issue acceptance criteria 2-4. Footer segment goes AFTER the bar segment. Footer marker substrings must stay byte-identical (feedback.py:46-48, poll.py). render_triage_markdown untouched.
close_reason: Implemented exact disclosures and review/audit provenance footers; targeted checks pass

title: tests/test_empty_draft.py — five cases, engine invocation counting
description: Follow tests/test_repo_audit.py: stdlib only, no live engine/forge, REVIEW_BOT_CLAUDE_CMD stub script that counts invocations to a file, reuse load_module/wire_review/_Args. Cases: empty draft standard depth (1 invocation, criterion-2 line, footer claude 0->0); 2 findings verifier->0 (2 invocations, criterion-3 line, footer 2->0); 2 findings verifier->1 (2 invocations, no disclosure line, footer 2->1); feedback.classify(body)=='review'; --mode repo empty draft (verify skipped, audit footer segment).

title: README: document the footer findings segment and the empty-finder disclosure
description: Update the review-output description in README.md.
close_reason: README documents exact disclosures and findings footer

title: Prefer the forge-recorded merge base; refuse an empty diff (forgejo olli/review-bot#23)
description: review.py --mode pr: use meta["merge_base"] from the PR payload as the merge base when it is present, resolvable locally and an ancestor of the converged PR head; otherwise fall back to today's live git merge-base and log why. Fixes reviewing an already-merged PR, where the live computation collapses to the head and the diff is 0 chars. Additionally changed_files_block refuses an empty diff with die() before the inline-cap test and before any engine call, --dry-run included. No new CLI surface. --mode issue/repo out of scope. New tests/test_merge_base.py (5 cases, stdlib-only, offline) + README.

title: prepare_checkout: prefer the forge-recorded merge base, with a guarded live fallback
description: Add a keyword-only param (default None) carrying the PR payload's merge_base; do_pr_review passes meta.get('merge_base'). Use it when present AND resolvable (git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}) AND an ancestor of the converged head (git merge-base --is-ancestor), on BOTH prepare_checkout paths (--repo-dir and cache-clone). In the cache-clone path resolve AFTER the head-sync convergence loop. Otherwise fall back to the live computation and continue — never abort. Probes must treat failure as a boolean, not an exception (check=False). Emit exactly one journal line: 'merge base <sha12> (forge-recorded)' or 'merge base <sha12> (computed live — <reason>)'. Issue criteria 1-6.

title: changed_files_block: refuse an empty diff instead of rendering a vacuous pass
description: die() when 'git diff <merge-base>..HEAD' produces no output — before the DIFF_INLINE_CAP comparison and before any engine call, --dry-run included. Non-zero exit, nothing posted. Message names the merge base and states nothing was reviewed. Issue criteria 7-8.

title: tests/test_merge_base.py — five cases, stdlib-only and offline
description: Model on tests/test_head_sync.py's bare file:// origin harness (publishes refs/pull/N/head, imports review.py via importlib, points FORGE_URL/CACHE_ROOT at a tempdir). Model a merged PR by fast-forwarding the branch into main in the bare origin while leaving refs/pull/1/head at the branch tip. Cases: (a) merged topology + usable recorded base -> non-empty diff naming the changed file; (b) same topology, no recorded base -> the collapse (regression guard); (c) non-ancestor recorded base -> live used, run continues, fallback journal line; (d) absent/empty recorded base -> live used, fallback line; (e) empty diff -> SystemExit. No existing test file may be edited. Issue criteria 9-11.

title: README: document merge-base sourcing and the empty-diff refusal
description: Extend the 'review.py -> review-bot-review-local' bullet (README.md:24-32, where the issue #16 head-sync behaviour is already documented): merge base comes from the forge's recorded value when usable (naming the merged-PR case it fixes), falls back to the live computation otherwise, and an empty diff is refused rather than reviewed. Issue criterion 12.

title: review-bot #39 — survive non-UTF-8 PR diffs and disclose undecodable files
description: A NUL-free non-UTF-8 file is text to git, so its raw bytes reach subprocess.run(text=True) and the strict decode kills the whole review. Decode leniently everywhere, then treat an undecodable file as one that could not be inlined: never packed, listed and marked in the not-inlined list, counted in the footer and journal. With zero undecodable files every emitted string stays byte-identical to f3f7611. Spec: olli/review-bot#39.

title: Lenient decode everywhere + regression test that fails pre-fix
description: Add encoding='utf-8', errors='replace' to git() (review.py:314) and to both engine subprocesses (select_files_to_inline, review.py:897; run_engine, review.py:1147). Also fix the test helper _git() at tests/test_diff_packing.py:117, which itself uses text=True and will crash on a non-UTF-8 fixture. Add a regression test proving a NUL-free non-UTF-8 diff no longer raises; verify it FAILS against the pre-fix tree (stash the review.py change, re-run, confirm, restore) and record the observed pre-fix failure in RESULT.md. Do NOT touch review.py:191 (Forgejo API read) or client.py:174.

title: Undecodable partition, DiffMode counter, footer/journal wordings, under-cap no-engine guard
description: In changed_files_block (review.py:941), partition chunks after split_diff_by_file into inlinable vs undecodable (chunk is undecodable iff U+FFFD in text). Undecodable chunks join elided regardless of budget and are never offered to the selection stage. total_files stays len(chunks). kind is 'inlined' only when no undecodable AND len(diff) <= cap; otherwise partial if anything kept else file-list. CRITICAL: the under-cap-with-undecodable case must run NO engine — assign Selection('disabled', detail='under cap') so the always-a-(selection ...)-suffix invariant holds (pinned by tests/test_diff_packing.py:331-336). Add DiffMode.undecodable_files; footer_word gains ', N undecodable' after any ', selected'; journal_phrase gains ', N not valid UTF-8' before the selection suffix, omitted when N is 0. Mark undecodable entries in the not-inlined list. GATES ON THE FULL SUITE AT CLOSE — DiffMode.__init__ is a shared signature.

title: README Diff input mode update + byte-identical-when-zero assertions + in-use exercise
description: Re-read every prose description of the changed strings, not just the nearest one: README.md '## Diff input mode' (line 215 on) mode table, journal-line bullet and footer-segment bullet, including the list of (selection ...) wordings which gains '(selection disabled: under cap)'. No documented example may show a shape the code cannot emit. Assert (do not eyeball) that with zero undecodable files the footer word, journal phrase and prompt block are byte-identical to f3f7611 for all four of inlined / partial / partial+selected / file-list. In-use exercise: drive changed_files_block against a REAL git repo built like make_edge_case_tree (tests/test_diff_packing.py:438) with a NUL-free invalid-UTF-8 file; confirm git does NOT report 'Binary files ... differ' for it before asserting anything else. Degenerate cases: all files undecodable (must degrade to file-list), and under-cap-with-undecodable (must produce partial with the engine NOT invoked — assert it).

title: review-bot #30 — derive empty_finder_is_genuine from a normalize* report
description: Make the empty-finder discriminator consume a report each normalize* emits, instead of hand-restating what normalize* does, so a normalize change cannot silently invalidate the diagnostic. Journal-only: posted comment, footer, N→M counts and feedback.py classification all unchanged. Forgejo olli/review-bot#30.

title: normalize/normalize_audit/normalize_triage emit the normalize report; thread it into the parse record
description: Each normalize* in review.py fills an optional mutable dict argument (the existing _fill_diag(diag, **fields) idiom at :1455) at the point each default/discard/schema decision happens. Fields, names prescriptive: schema (review|audit|triage), schema_has_verdict (bool), findings_source (absent|null|list|non-list:<typename>; n/a for triage), findings_received (int or None unless findings_source=='list'), findings_discarded (int), verdict_source (engine|absent|unrecognised|n/a), disposition_source (same domain). 'engine' only when the raw value was in VERDICT_LABEL / DISPOSITIONS respectively. Do NOT change what normalize* returns — every existing caller keeps working untouched. Then _parse_engine_output (:1580) — the one place calling both norm(obj) and _describe_parsed(obj, path) on the same object — threads the report from norm into the parse record under a new key; both call sites (:1624, :1652). No reporting of severity coercion. Full 13-file suite must pass at close.
close_reason: normalize reports emitted and threaded; full suite green

title: Consumers read the report: discriminator, triage default check, journal wording
description: empty_finder_is_genuine (:1471) rewritten to apply the truth table to the report — genuine iff findings_source=='null', OR (findings_source=='list' AND findings_received==0), OR (findings_source=='absent' AND schema_has_verdict AND verdict_source=='engine'). Everything else defaulted, including every non-list:* shape and any list that arrived non-empty. Signature stays (parse, mode) positional. Its docstring describes the report vocabulary instead of restating normalize*. triage_disposition_was_defaulted (:1526) becomes disposition_source != 'engine' (2 callers: :1903, :1922). log_empty_finder_diagnostic (:1501) renders the 'present' / 'ABSENT — defaulted' note (:1514) from verdict_source, and journals the discriminator's own conclusion. _describe_findings (:1460) renders 'list of N — every entry discarded by normalize' from findings_discarded, wording byte-identical. _describe_parsed (:1425) UNCHANGED — keeps emitting path/keys/verdict_raw/verdict_present/disposition_raw/disposition_present/findings_kind/findings_len under today's exact names. Legacy branch: when no report is present, apply the vocabulary map then the SAME single decision. This bead changes shared behaviour — run the FULL 13-file suite at its close, not just the touched suites.
close_reason: report consumers implemented; all 13 test files green

title: Coupling test + test_diff_mode case 11 arm + run mutations M1/M2
description: New coupling test in tests/test_empty_draft.py (existing 18 cases stay; cases 4-9 and 17 must pass UNEDITED). For a table of raw engine objects driven through the real normalize / normalize_audit / normalize_triage, assert: findings_discarded == findings_received - len(result['findings']) whenever findings_source=='list'; verdict_source=='engine' iff result['verdict'] equals the raw object's verdict (likewise disposition_source against normalize_triage); findings_source matches the raw findings value's actual shape; report-derived and legacy-derived discriminator agree on every row. Cover at minimum: explicit []; null; absent key with a recognised verdict; absent key with a quoted schema string as the verdict; a list of two dicts; a list whose entries are all non-dicts; a mixed list; {} / '' / 0 as the findings value; and the audit and triage schemas. tests/test_diff_mode.py case 11 gains one arm driving a report-carrying diag; its legacy fixtures (:355-361, :648-659) stay and must keep passing. Then run mutation M1 (delete normalize's 'if not isinstance(f, dict): continue' guard) and M2 (drop normalize's 'if verdict not in VERDICT_LABEL' correction); each must break at least one test with empty_finder_is_genuine UNTOUCHED. Revert both — neither may be left in the tree. Record the observed failure output verbatim in RESULT.md.

title: finder_ab reads the journalled conclusion; README doc-drift
description: tools/finder_ab.py describe_empty_diag (:283-310): replace the re-derivation (the kind/length mirror around :301-305) with a read of the journalled discriminator conclusion WHEN the diag carries one, keeping the current legacy branch for pre-report journals. Rewrite its in-code comment (and the VERDICT_VALUES comment at :92-93) to say what it now does. Do NOT make review.py importable, do NOT add a shared module, do NOT touch default.nix. README.md: rewrite the three-bullet discriminator rule at :172-188 to decide from the report's fields; the field list at :167 gains the report alongside the raw _describe_parsed facts it already names and KEEPS findings_kind / findings_len (those are still emitted; cases 4-9 pin them). No prose may claim the discriminator reads them directly. Run grep -rn 'findings_kind\|findings_len' README.md as a review aid, not a zero-hit gate — check each surviving hit describes the journal's raw parse record rather than the discriminator, and say so in RESULT.md.
